name: myfbox
description: Controle financeiro pessoal local-first, cifrado no dispositivo (AES-256-GCM), para Web e Desktop (Electron), com modo MCP local.

scripts.electron:build: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.writeFileSync('dist-electron/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }) + '\n')"
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:41730 && npm run electron:build && electron . --dev"
scripts.electron:start: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron .
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --mac
